$comment: Institutions (domain/institutions/spec.md, INST): the Empire and the Shogunate. Values from the institutions design of 18 October 2026 (/mnt/project-files/institutions/institutions-design.md). Every number is a placeholder balancing knob. members_1444 is the design's worked X-13 match of the catalogue's imperial estates to map realms (OQ-INST-1: the Teutonic Order, nominal in the catalogue, is left out as the design lists it).

reforms.name: Public Peace
reforms.effect: A member that makes war on another member becomes a Breaker of the Peace.

reforms.name: Imperial Court
reforms.effect: Members take quarrels over land to court instead of to war.

reforms.name: Circles
reforms.effect: Every member of a circle joins the defence when an outsider attacks one of them.

reforms.name: Common Tax
reforms.effect: Every member pays 5 in 100 of its tax to the Emperor in place of the dues.

reforms.name: Imperial Army
reforms.effect: In a war to defend the Empire the Emperor commands a tenth of every member's soldiers.

reforms.name: Hereditary Crown
reforms.effect: The Emperor's heir takes the crown; no more elections.

reforms.name: One Realm
reforms.effect: Every member's ruler becomes a great lord of the Emperor, and the Empire becomes one realm.

circles.$comment: OQ-INST-2 default: the historical circles of 1512 matched to map members; Bohemia, Switzerland and the Italian members sat in no circle.
